def get_config_dir():
    """Returns the configuration directory path."""
    return "/etc"

def get_scan_command():
    """Returns the scan command."""
    return "find"

def get_scan_args():
    """Returns the scan arguments for finding recently modified config files."""
    return "-type f -newer /var/log/installer"

def get_reset_command():
    """Returns the reset command for deleting custom configs."""
    return "rm -f"

import subprocess
import os

config_path = get_config_dir()
files = subprocess.check_output(f"{get_scan_command()} {config_path} {get_scan_args()}", shell=True).decode().strip().split('\n')

for file in files:
    subprocess.run(f"{get_reset_command()} {file}", shell=True)
